name: AI Hardware Fundamentals: GPUs, CPUs, Memory, Networking and Storage
description: A plain-language tour of the hardware that runs AI: why AI is limited by compute, memory bandwidth and data movement; what GPUs, HBM and precision formats are; how servers, networks, storage, power and cooling fit together; and how to size a simple inference or training system and weigh cloud against buying.

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 20 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
